views.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create detailed natural 16:9 watercolor game-background preview for The Grand Tour scene22 BANTEAY SREI / 女王宫, front approach and sanctuary group. Reference1 APSARA National Authority official original https://apsaraauthority.gov.kh/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Apsara-National-Authority-Banteay-Srei-temple-2.jpg is the SOLE source of architecture, composition, proportions and conservation condition. Reference2 approved Thommanon watercolor is STYLE ONLY, no transfer of its building. Paint exactly photographed three small reddish-pink sandstone tiered sanctuary towers behind layered lower doorways and richly carved pediments, central tallest tower, side towers and their actual partial occlusions and unequal heights. Preserve detailed weathered floral carving, dark joints, irregular missing stone, roofless side masonry, central peaked carved doorway pediment, two flanking stone-baluster windows, side rectangular openings. Keep actual pale conservation diagonal brace inside central doorway and wooden barrier, photographed low wooden visitor walkways at sides and conservation ropes/stakes, not invent intact walls or perfect symmetry. Broad sandy reddish approach runs from foreground center toward doorway, repeated short rounded weathered stone boundary posts along both sides decreasing in size, grass at sides, dense green forest fills background with no invented blue skyline above towers. Maintain exact tower number and doorway alignments. Adapt 3:2 source to16:9 by modest nearest dirt crop and slight lateral forest/earth extension only, do not crop main tower tops, stretch or rebuild architecture. Warm natural daylight, nuanced pink ochre sandstone and muted green forest, delicate clearly readable architectural carving and masonry brushwork, layered translucent watercolor washes, subtle cotton-paper grain, excellent depth. Match approved detailed travel picture-book series, not loose blurry watercolor, harsh outlines, photorealism or photo filter. Remove small text signs only, retain conservation boundaries. No people, game characters, text, logo, watermark, UI or border. Archived archaeological condition, no speculative reconstruction.
